name: Notification Bar
description: Slim site-wide announcement bar (top or bottom): message + optional CTA link, dismissible with version-based re-show, colors, and an optional schedule window.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Read the notification bar configuration option (message, colors, schedule, version).
Save the notification bar configuration option from the admin page.
Expose the public config endpoint the bar script consumes plus the admin read/save endpoints.
Add the announcement bar entry to the admin sidebar.
Enqueue public/bar.js and public/bar.css so the announcement bar renders on every public page.
